declarations.description:
ReactiveController managing gapless 24kHz PCM audio playback, interruption
flushing, and audio-reactive frequency analysis (`AnalyserNode`).

Audio routing follows the Audio-Reactive Mute pattern:
  BufferSource -> AnalyserNode -> OutputGainNode -> AudioContext.destination
Muting sets `OutputGainNode.gain.value = 0` so the visualizer remains
reactive to model speech even when speaker output is muted.
declarations.name: PcmPlayerController

declarations.description:
Keyboard "roving tabindex" for composite widgets (radio groups, tab lists).

Only one item is in the tab order (`tabindex="0"`); Arrow keys, Home and End
move focus between items, wrapping at the ends. Left/Right are mirrored in
right-to-left layouts. The host decides which item is current by calling
`sync(index)` after each render.
declarations.name: RovingFocusController

members.name: sync
members.description: Puts item `index` (or the first item, if out of range) in the tab order.

declarations.description:
The single source of truth for Gemini Live Studio design tokens.

- `tokens.css` (generated by `npm run tokens`, checked by a unit test)
  turns these into `--ga-*` CSS custom properties per theme.
- `tailwind.config.ts` maps every colour to `rgb(var(--ga-color-*) / <alpha>)`,
  so utility classes such as `bg-primary/10` keep working and follow the
  active theme.
- Canvas / JS code reads colours at runtime with `readColorToken()`.

Themes are selected with `data-theme="light" | "dark" | "system"` on
`<html>` (or any ancestor). With no attribute the light theme applies.

This module must stay free of side effects and imports so that Node scripts
and the Tailwind config can load it directly.

declarations.name: colorVar
declarations.description: CSS custom property name for a colour token.

declarations.name: hexToChannels
declarations.description: "#4285F4" -> "66 133 244" (space-separated channels for rgb(var() / a)).

declarations.name: tokenCss
declarations.description: Generates the contents of `src/theme/tokens.css`.

declarations.name: readColorToken
declarations.description:
Reads a colour token from the computed style of `el` (so it follows the
active theme) and returns it as an `rgb()`/`rgba()` string for canvas use.

declarations.name: colorTokenReader
declarations.description:
Like `readColorToken`, but resolves the computed style once and returns a
reader, for code that needs many colours per frame (canvas render loops).

declarations.name: setTheme
declarations.description: Applies a theme to the document root.
